title: Kombai people - Wikipedia
text: April 12, 2026 - The Kombai are a Papuan people living in the Indonesian province of South Papua, more specifically in Mappi Regency. Their total population is about 5,650. The name kombay comes from the word khoba, meaning 'people', and their language is called khobaye-lu meaning 'human language'.
